note: R3. Eight scenes, one per Kingdom Work, in balance order (the sheet was painted in that order): granary, library, treasure vault, armoury, gatehouse, courier stables, banner hall, throne room. The sheet paints them 1.41:1 inside a thin gold frame; the cards' windows are 1.25:1, so each scene is cut inside its frame to that shape, centred, and the frame is cut once, hollow, and drawn as a nine-patch at both sizes.
